threads.topic: You've got the Harukiya's piano bench on your table.
threads.source: FICTION, invented for the game; see design/V2_ADELA_SOUND_PICTURE_PLOT_2026-11-01.md. Actual loose fitting, then he expects decent workmanship. The bench keeps her music, which is why Mae's drawer never touches it.

ob_w1.line: Third time. Brushes are fine, bearing's fine, I put it right and it goes wrong the same way, like it's been told. I used to laugh at a man for fighting a windmill. Then I grew up and learned who owned it.

ob_w2.line: Fella at the Vantry shop told me there's a direction in which every knot comes loose. I've searched the workshop and can't find it. Hold that end. Not like that. You hold it like it owes you something.

ob_v1.line: It was plumb on Tuesday. I checked it Tuesday. The clergyman says God is in the walls. I should like to speak to Him about the rent.

ob_b1.line: Bell starts it. Wet cell keeps it going if the house goes out. That's all it does.

choices.label: So it tells you who came in.

ob_b2.line: It tells you the bell rang. She said that too. Paid extra for the bell. I said now you can prove you have one. She laughed at that for a while, considering.

ob_b3.line: For the cell. Wet cells want topping and she's a woman who forgets a thing's alive unless it's got a face. Hook behind my bench. It's there now. Go look at it, it's not a confession.

ob_p1.line: Me. "Breaker reset, three-oh-two." I was down at three for the check and the board was out, and I stood in the dark with a good flashlight and a bad feeling and I reset it. That's the job. It came up and there she was, you could hear her through the wall. Teresa. Saying it.

ob_p2.line: A stroke on the tank at nine-oh-one, is what I wrote. It's what you'd write. The cut-out's rated for it. It shouldn't have stayed out. Six hours is bad work and I'd like to know whose.

ob_a1.line: First fire Saturday, I rake Monday, eight a.m., like the sheet says. And here's a dark slide. Warped. Glass doesn't burn with the rubbish. It makes you deal with it after. "A.V. 13." Somebody shovelled that in with the slack and thought it'd go.

choices.label: Can you get anything off it?

ob_a2.line: I can get it out without breaking it. Anything past that, you want someone who's paid to look. Six A. Carry it flat. Flat. Give it here, I'll carry it.

ob_n1.line: Hinge. Somebody's keeping a library in it and somebody gets up off it fast. I put in a longer pin. She asked could it go quieter. I said she could get up quieter. She said that was the number. So it's a longer pin.
